article_title: Party Rock Anthem singer Lauren Bennett struggled with mental health, inquest finds

tasks.prompt: What is the main focus of the article?
options: An inquest found that singer Lauren Bennett had experienced severe mental health difficulties before her death.
G.R.L announced a new album after a long break.
Billboard removed Party Rock Anthem from its charts.
A court investigated the business history of LMFAO.
tasks.correct_answer: An inquest found that singer Lauren Bennett had experienced severe mental health difficulties before her death.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מדווחת על ממצאי החקירה המשפטית שלפיהם לורן בנט התמודדה עם קשיים נפשיים חמורים לפני מותה.

tasks.prompt: What did Kenny Wormald say about the period immediately before Bennett's death?
options: She had announced a farewell concert.
She had stopped speaking to every family member.
There had been no indication that she planned to end her life.
She had decided to return to the Paradiso Girls.
tasks.correct_answer: There had been no indication that she planned to end her life.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בעלה אמר שהם דיברו על הכול ושלא היה סימן לכך שהיא עומדת לשים קץ לחייה.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what is Fragile X syndrome described as?
options: A reaction caused only by medication
A genetic disorder that can cause anxiety, mood instability and depression
A temporary illness caused by lack of sleep
A condition linked to alcohol or illicit drugs
tasks.correct_answer: A genetic disorder that can cause anxiety, mood instability and depression
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתארת את תסמונת ה־X השביר כהפרעה גנטית שעלולה לגרום לחרדה, לחוסר יציבות במצב הרוח ולדיכאון.

tasks.prompt: What does “inquest” mean in the context of the article?
options: A music-industry award ceremony
A hospital treatment programme
A private family meeting
An official investigation into the circumstances of a death
tasks.correct_answer: An official investigation into the circumstances of a death
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר הזה inquest היא חקירה רשמית הבודקת את נסיבות המוות.

tasks.prompt: How did Wormald locate Bennett after she did not return from her walk?
options: He used Find My iPhone to trace her device.
Police followed a message on social media.
A member of G.R.L called him with her location.
He found a note naming a concert venue.
tasks.correct_answer: He used Find My iPhone to trace her device.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה, הוא השתמש ב־Find My iPhone כדי לאתר את המכשיר שלה והגיע למקום כפרי.

tasks.prompt: Which fact does the article give about Party Rock Anthem?
options: It was Bennett's first solo single.
It won a court award in Kent.
Billboard named it the fifth most successful song of all time.
Its video was watched fewer than one million times.
tasks.correct_answer: Billboard named it the fifth most successful song of all time.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציינת שבילבורד דירג את השיר במקום החמישי בין השירים המצליחים ביותר בכל הזמנים.

tasks.prompt: Describe two events in Bennett's mental-health history that the inquest heard about.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני אירועים מדויקים מהכתבה ולמקם אותם ברצף הזמן ככל האפשר.
expected_points: She had previously been diagnosed with Fragile X syndrome.
In January before her death, she went several days without sleep and was admitted to hospital under a mental health section.
She experienced substantial psychological suffering after that admission and remained under specialist mental-health care.

tasks.prompt: What details suggest that Bennett's difficulties continued despite receiving professional care?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסיק מן הכתבה ולתמוך בתשובה בשתי ראיות לפחות, בלי לקבוע אבחנות שאינן מופיעות בה.
expected_points: She was under specialist mental-health services at the time of her death.
She had reacted poorly to medication.
She did not believe she was going to get better.
The coroner noted substantial psychological suffering after her hospital admission.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the inquest report and Bennett's music career in 3–4 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לשלב את ממצא החקירה, רקע קצר על מצבה הנפשי ושתי עובדות מרכזיות מקריירת המוזיקה.
expected_points: The inquest concluded that Bennett took her own life after severe mental-health struggles.
She had Fragile X syndrome, had been admitted to hospital and was receiving specialist care.
She was a member of G.R.L and had previously performed with the Paradiso Girls.
She featured on LMFAO's Party Rock Anthem, a major chart and video success.

tasks.prompt: Write a brief, respectful news introduction that reports the inquest finding without sensational language.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב פתיח עובדתי, רגיש ומדויק; לציין את ממצא החקירה ואת זהותה של בנט בלי פרטים גרפיים או ניסוח דרמטי.
expected_points: Identify Lauren Bennett as a British singer associated with G.R.L and Party Rock Anthem.
State that an inquest examined her death and heard about severe mental-health difficulties.
Use neutral, compassionate language and avoid speculation.
